components.name: Alert
components.coverage: Four semantic types, optional description, controlled dismissal and full-width banner. Use Message for transient mutation feedback. Source-contract implementation; browser and real-App acceptance remain manual.

components.name: Anchor
components.coverage: Three-level section navigation, container-aware scroll and active tracking; ordinary clicks preserve App hash routing. Source-contract implementation; browser and real-App acceptance remain manual.

components.name: Avatar
components.coverage: Four sizes and seven colors, bordered icons, person/department combinations, capsule, subtitle and guarded editing; image-error fallback. Source-contract implementation; browser and real-App acceptance remain manual.

components.name: Badge
components.coverage: Three sizes, dot, count, overflow count, muted and five icon states, standalone or target/Avatar composition. Source-contract implementation; browser and real-App acceptance remain manual.

components.name: Breadcrumb

components.name: Button
components.coverage: Primary/secondary/outline/text/danger/success/warning/dashed, four sizes, leading/trailing icons, icon-only, loading/disabled, joined groups and split actions. Source-contract implementation; browser and real-App acceptance remain manual.

components.name: Cascader
components.coverage: Single and multiple leaf paths, local full-path search, groups/icons, disabled subtrees, parent checkbox selection and column keyboard navigation. Source-contract implementation; browser and real-App acceptance remain manual.

components.name: Checkbox

components.name: Descriptions

components.name: Drawer

components.name: Dropdown

components.name: Modal

components.name: PageHeader

components.name: Pagination
components.coverage: Basic, total count, page-size chooser, validated jump and simple modes; bounded controlled pages and disabled controls. Source-contract implementation; browser and real-App acceptance remain manual.

components.name: Popconfirm
components.coverage: Anchored default/icon/description and simple confirmation; controlled success/failure and busy dismissal guards. Source-contract implementation; browser and real-App acceptance remain manual.

components.name: Progress

components.name: SegmentedPicker
components.coverage: Four source sizes, controlled primitive values, disabled items and radio-group keyboard navigation. Source-contract implementation; browser and real-App acceptance remain manual.

components.name: Select
components.coverage: Single/multiple, four sizes, native-like states, grouped/empty/search panels, removable and overflow tags, clear and inset labels; controlled typed values. Source-contract implementation; browser and real-App acceptance remain manual.

components.name: Slider
components.coverage: Default/small native single-value and dual-handle ranges; bounds, step, disabled and non-crossing updates. Source-contract implementation; browser and real-App acceptance remain manual.

components.name: StatusTag
components.coverage: Text/fill/outline variants for success/warning/processing/stop/error/loading/waiting; visible labels and reduced-motion loading. Source-contract implementation; browser and real-App acceptance remain manual.

components.name: Steps
components.coverage: Horizontal/vertical ordered steps with or without descriptions; completed/active/pending/disabled/error states and parent-owned progress. Source-contract implementation; browser and real-App acceptance remain manual.

components.name: Switch

components.name: Table
components.coverage: Source table with selection, striped rows, cell/action slots, toolbar and pagination composition; controlled sorting and centered load/empty/error states. Source-contract implementation; browser and real-App acceptance remain manual.

components.name: Tabs
components.coverage: Line/card/capsule/button/segmented/vertical variants, sizes, icons/counts/badges, scroll/add/extra controls and optional bordered content panels. Source-contract implementation; browser and real-App acceptance remain manual.

components.name: TimePicker
components.coverage: Single/range local time strings, default/large/small, seconds, placeholders and disabled/readonly/error states; native panel, parent validates range order. Source-contract implementation; browser and real-App acceptance remain manual.

components.name: Tooltip
components.coverage: Top/bottom/left/right, opposite-side flip and viewport clamp, hover/focus/Escape with top-layer support. Source-contract implementation; browser and real-App acceptance remain manual.

components.name: TopNav
components.coverage: Light/dark header, optional product tabs, secondary navigation, links/search/actions; business owns navigation and optional menu trigger. Source-contract implementation; browser and real-App acceptance remain manual.

provenance.implementation: Kooboo native-ESM Vue runtime derived from Yuanli visual contracts; reference material and build inputs are maintained outside the consumption package.

provenance.upstreamAssessment: The original visual reference was not a reusable Vue library. This package exposes the documented executable exports; implementation coverage and browser acceptance are separate.
